maxcraft.gui.factory_panel.crafting_inpu: Part of the %s pattern this gauge is set to work with.
maxcraft.tooltip.large_package_component: Right click a Packager, Re-Packager or Stock Ticker with it to upgrade that machine in place; its logistics network, settings and contents are kept.
Craft it with a Factory Gauge for an Extended Factory Gauge, or right click a gauge panel to enlarge that panel's crafting grid.
maxcraft.tooltip.large_packager.1: Fills 27 stacks into a single package (adjustable in the server config).
maxcraft.tooltip.large_packager.2: What comes out is still an ordinary package - frogports, postboxes, unpacking and the Repackager all handle it.
maxcraft.tooltip.large_repackager.1: Waits for the whole order to arrive, then merges it into one package.
maxcraft.tooltip.large_repackager.2: Packages without order information, such as a redstone request, still merge the way they always did.
maxcraft.tooltip.extended_stock_ticker.1: Raises the number of item types one order may contain from 9 to 27.
maxcraft.tooltip.extended_stock_ticker.2: The order bar is still nine wide; anything past that shows as [+N], and clicking an item in the stock grid adjusts its amount.
maxcraft.tooltip.packager: Right click it with a Large Package Component to upgrade it into a Large Packager.
maxcraft.tooltip.repackager: Right click it with a Large Package Component to upgrade it into a Large Re-Packager.
maxcraft.tooltip.stock_ticker: Right click it with a Large Package Component to upgrade it into an Extended Stock Ticker, keeping its network and categories.
maxcraft.tooltip.factory_gauge.1: Right click a panel with a Large Package Component to enlarge that panel's crafting grid.
maxcraft.tooltip.factory_gauge.2: A gauge's four panels are independent: enlarging one never touches the other three.
Extended Factory Gauge: this gauge's panels can work with a larger crafting grid.
Right click a panel with another Large Package Component to enlarge it further.
